title: Professor Armitage

[[Image:ProfessorArmitage.png|thumb]]
'''Professor Armitage''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Historical Society]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Lore]]

Your attacks are not affected by [[Magical Resistance]].

==Mythos Source==
Professor Henry Armitage appears in the story ''The Dunwich Horror'', written by H.P. Lovecraft (1928). He is the head librarian at [[Miskatonic University]].
